donor_format.ref: bathtub_kart.kfb-vehicle.json (V-273): KayKit car frame, glTF +Z forward, +X = car left, +Y up; wheel spin about local X

frame.origin: ground below the midpoint of the two axles

units.note: V-311 v2 scale: racers 5.664, haulers 7.363 rig per Meshy unit (= v1 x 1.92; haulers keep their extra x1.3)

nodes.ironclad_wrecker: root, body mesh (single fused mesh, 1 material)

nodes.kfb_driver_hidden: empty, cockpit centre where the character is hidden
nodes.kfb_camera_follow: empty, suggested chase-camera position (target in anchors)
nodes.kfb_wheel_<FL|FR|RL|RR>: EMPTY hub anchor (no mesh), origin = hub centre, spin axis local +X, steer axis local +Y (front pair); extras kfb_fused=true, kfb_radius

kfb_entry.note: ground point beside the door/cockpit side; hop-in arc ends at kfb_driver_hidden

kfb_wheel_FL.note: EMPTY hub anchor (wheel geometry fused into the body); spin axis local X, steer axis local Y (front)

kfb_wheel_FR.note: EMPTY hub anchor (wheel geometry fused into the body); spin axis local X, steer axis local Y (front)

Crane arm + hook fused into the body (no rig)

render_path.lighting: WS1 stage: NoToneMapping, sRGB output, Hemisphere 0xfff4e0/0x3a3226 1.25 + sun 1.8, no env map

wheel_split.reason: source is ONE connected island (3D scan-like Meshy mesh); wheel surfaces merge into arches/skirts/struts, no clean cut boundary. Per V-273 addendum: keep fused, WS1 uses invisible physics wheels + these hub anchors.

rigClassScale.note: medium = this file (FrizzleBob v5b / Rig_Medium seated fits the closed 02 cabin). large = PROPOSAL only: Orc Brute (Rig_Large) needs the car x1.33 larger again, measured the same way in 02 (smallest x2.545 of v1, 2.545/1.920 = 1.326, rounded up)

seat_fit.pose: KayKit Character Animations 1.1 · Rig_Medium_Simulation.glb · Sit_Chair_Idle @1.0 s
seat_fit.placement: pelvis x/z on kfb_driver_hidden, facing +Z; lowest foot on the hull floor (raycast down from kfb_driver_hidden)
seat_fit.method: three.js Raycaster against the 100k-tri browser hull: head+ears up, shoulders +-X, hips down; inside = first hit is an exit face
seat_fit.criteria: head/ears >= 5 cm below roof, shoulders inside side walls, hips above floor
seat_fit.note: same factor applied to all 11 racers (relative sizes kept); only 02 is guaranteed by measurement, other cabins were not fitted individually

stickers_v2.method: logo areas projected from ortho views onto the mesh and repainted in UV space (base colour WebP 2048; normal flattened, metal/rough levelled under the patch)

v2_build.from: v1 browser GLB rescaled x1.92 about the ground origin (geometry, UVs, simplification identical to v1)
